## How I tested it

<!-- `pnpm check` is the gate and CI runs it. Say what you tried by hand, on a phone width and on a desktop width. -->

- [ ] The acceptance criteria of the issue are met
- [ ] `pnpm check` passes
- [ ] New behavior has a test next to the kind of thing it tests (`docs/test-standards.md`)
- [ ] A change visible on screen was looked at in 390 px and in 1440 px

## Checklist

- [ ] No real user data, secrets or message content anywhere in the diff
- [ ] Docs, `GLOSSARY.md` or an ADR updated if behavior or vocabulary changed
- [ ] New text exists in English and pt-BR and follows `docs/copy-standards.md`
- [ ] SEO rules of `docs/seo-standards.md` still hold (the SEO tests pass)
